rules: Owned by packages/protocol/src/refusal-ledger.test.ts; see specs/done/launch-video-feedback/README.md. codes: every UPPER_SNAKE string literal in product source, with a category and per-file counts. Refusal categories: malformed, ambiguous, conflict, resource-bound, missing-prerequisite, destructive, execution-failure. issue-code: an UPPER_SNAKE diagnostic reported on output (a per-item warning or state), never a refusal; it stays outside the kebab-case issue registry. not-a-refusal: another constant. refusedStatus: files allowed a 'refused' status literal, each for a caller-authored verdict. No quality gate refuses, and no code hides inside a message text.

refusedStatus.packages/composition/src/edits.ts: reads a caller-authored synchronization verdict to report it as an issue
refusedStatus.packages/core/src/alignment-evidence.ts: retained alignment-worker evidence keeps the worker's own verdict word
refusedStatus.packages/core/src/alignment-operands.ts: retained alignment-worker evidence keeps the worker's own verdict word
refusedStatus.packages/core/src/speaker-continuity.ts: an evaluation verdict over measured gates, like synchronization evidence; retained receipts keep it

ABORTED.reason: Cancel ends this attempt, not the validity of the request.

ACQUISITION_BUSY.reason: An existing worker can release its library lock.
ACQUISITION_BUSY.cause: Another import still owns the library.

ACQUISITION_NOT_FOUND.reason: The referenced acquisition is absent; the current true ledger value contradicts the missing-reference rule.
ACQUISITION_NOT_FOUND.cause: The referenced import does not exist.

ACQUISITION_PATH_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Access to the retained source directory can be repaired.
ACQUISITION_PATH_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The import’s source folder cannot be opened.

AMBIGUOUS_PREPARED_AUDIO.reason: The request needs an explicit retained-output selection.
AMBIGUOUS_PREPARED_AUDIO.cause: Several prepared audio outputs match this request.

APP_CLOSING.reason: App lifetime can be renewed and the same operation requested again.

APP_NOT_FOUND.reason: The app is our installation; reinstalling or repairing configuration can restore it.
APP_NOT_FOUND.cause: The Yap app cannot be found at its configured location.

APP_QUIT.reason: This interruption describes app lifetime, not a permanently invalid request.
APP_QUIT.cause: Yap quit before the take finished normally.

ARCHIVE_CHANGED.reason: Assembly and admission operate on our staged files; restaging can repair them.
ARCHIVE_CHANGED.cause: The package files changed while they were being copied.

ARCHIVE_CLEANUP_FAILED.reason: Workspace cleanup can succeed after filesystem repair.
ARCHIVE_CLEANUP_FAILED.cause: A temporary package folder could not be cleaned up.

ARTIFACT_CHANGED.reason: A caller pin to another generation/range/identity cannot select the requested immutable result; owned-file cases must split as described below.
ARTIFACT_CHANGED.cause: The requested output no longer matches its pinned identity.

ARTIFACT_EXPIRED.reason: Derived bytes can be prepared again; expired delivery-token references need the separate treatment below.
ARTIFACT_EXPIRED.cause: The prepared output is no longer available.

ASSET_CONFLICT.reason: Our content-addressed asset bytes or metadata need repair, not different caller parameters.
ASSET_CONFLICT.cause: Stored media conflicts with its recorded identity.

ASSET_DELETED.reason: A deleted asset identity cannot be recreated by replaying its import request.

AUDIO_FORMAT_CHANGED.reason: Device or capture implementation recovery can make another attempt succeed.
AUDIO_FORMAT_CHANGED.cause: The audio device changed its format during capture.

AUDIO_OVERLAP.reason: Capture clock classification is our implementation, even though the ledger calls this an issue.

AUDIO_PUBLICATION_PARTIAL.reason: Unresolved captured audio can be recovered or republished.
AUDIO_PUBLICATION_PARTIAL.cause: Some recorded audio has not been published yet.

AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The immutable take has no retained or verified playable frames for the requested audio; retry cannot create them.
AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The recorded audio has no playable frames.

CACHE_BUSY.reason: Readers can release the cache budget.
CACHE_BUSY.cause: Prepared output is still being read.

CAMERA_FORMAT_CHANGED.reason: The device can return to a usable format.
CAMERA_FORMAT_CHANGED.cause: The camera changed its picture format during the take.

CAMERA_NOT_RESERVED.reason: This take’s admitted allocation contains no companion camera.
CAMERA_NOT_RESERVED.cause: This take did not reserve a companion camera.

CAMERA_NOT_TURNED_ON.reason: A completed take cannot acquire pictures from a camera never used.
CAMERA_NOT_TURNED_ON.cause: The camera stayed off for this take.

CAMERA_PERMISSION_REQUIRED.reason: Granting camera access can make the identical operation succeed.

CAMERA_TOGGLE_LIMIT.reason: This is our capture counter limit, subject to the limits audit, not invalid caller data.
CAMERA_TOGGLE_LIMIT.cause: The take reached Yap’s camera-toggle limit.

CANCELED.reason: Cancellation is explicitly retryable under the contract.

CAPACITY_EXCEEDED.reason: Queue or execution capacity can become free.
CAPACITY_EXCEEDED.cause: Too much work is already waiting or running.

CAPTURE_BUSY.reason: The capture or journal owner can release its lock.
CAPTURE_BUSY.cause: Another capture operation is still active.

CAPTURE_EVIDENCE_FAILED.reason: Our clock/journal writer can recover after a code or machine repair.
CAPTURE_EVIDENCE_FAILED.cause: Capture could not retain its timing evidence.

CAPTURE_INTERRUPTED.reason: Capture interruption does not invalidate an explicit retry.

CAPTURE_NOT_QUIET.cause: Recording or media work is still active.

CAPTURE_RECOVERED.reason: Recovery is successful status; do not turn its diagnostic into a permanent refusal.
CAPTURE_RECOVERED.cause: The take was recovered after an interruption.

CAPTURE_RECOVERY_PENDING.cause: The take is still being recovered.

CAPTURE_RECOVERY_UNRESOLVED.reason: Unproved native closure is our recovery state, not evidence of invalid input.
CAPTURE_RECOVERY_UNRESOLVED.cause: The take’s recovery has not been confirmed.

CLEANUP_FAILED.reason: Our publication cleanup can succeed after repair.
CLEANUP_FAILED.cause: Capture cleanup could not be verified.

CLEANUP_PENDING.cause: Temporary capture files still need cleanup.

CLEANUP_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Permissions or I/O to our capture files can recover.
CLEANUP_UNAVAILABLE.cause: Capture cleanup cannot read its files right now.

CLI_TIMEOUT.reason: A later CLI execution can answer.
CLI_TIMEOUT.cause: The Yap command did not answer in time.

CLI_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our executable or its installation can be repaired.
CLI_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The Yap command could not be started.

CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The machine’s synchronization clock can become usable.
CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The selected device’s clock is unavailable.

CONFLICT.reason: A durable import request or generation already belongs to different input.
CONFLICT.cause: This transcript request identity was used for another source.

CONNECTION_CLOSED.reason: A new connection can carry the same request.
CONNECTION_CLOSED.cause: The connection ended before a complete answer arrived.

CONNECTION_ERROR.cause: Yap could not connect to its local service.

CONTEXT_CLOSED.reason: The exact process-local package handle has ended; opening a new handle changes the reference.

CONTROL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.reason: The oversized message is produced by our service control channel.
CONTROL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.cause: The service sent a control message larger than Yap accepts.

CONTROL_PROTOCOL.reason: Our app/service protocol implementation can be repaired.
CONTROL_PROTOCOL.cause: The app could not understand a service control message.

CONTROL_RESPONSE_INVALID.reason: Our service’s control response can be corrected.
CONTROL_RESPONSE_INVALID.cause: The service returned an invalid control response.

COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE.reason: Our delivery verification can be repaired; this diagnostic does not authorize edits.
COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE.cause: Delivery evidence does not cover every requested item.

COVERAGE_OVERCLAIM.reason: Our evidence writer can correct its claimed coverage.
COVERAGE_OVERCLAIM.cause: Delivery evidence claims coverage it does not demonstrate.

CROSS_DEVICE_PUBLICATION.reason: Our staging placement can be repaired on the same filesystem as the destination.
CROSS_DEVICE_PUBLICATION.cause: Export staging and its destination are on different filesystems.

DECODE_FAILED.reason: Our decoder or machine can recover.

DELETE_FAILED.reason: Filesystem deletion or cleanup can succeed later.
DELETE_FAILED.cause: The item could not be deleted completely.

DELETE_IN_PROGRESS.reason: Our deletion/publication fence can clear; requests tied to a confirmed deleting or deleted owner use OWNER_DELETED instead.
DELETE_IN_PROGRESS.cause: Media deletion or publication is still being settled.

DEPENDENCY_FAILED.reason: A prerequisite execution can be explicitly retried.
DEPENDENCY_FAILED.cause: Work required by this operation failed.

DEPENDENCY_LOST.reason: The derived prerequisite can be prepared again.

DEPENDENCY_REFUSED.reason: Reserve this wrapper for a permanently invalid dependency request/reference; repairable helper causes must keep their retryable code.
DEPENDENCY_REFUSED.cause: A required operation could not be completed.

DESTINATION_CHANGED.reason: The saved replacement identity names a different file; repeating it cannot authorize replacing the new file.
DESTINATION_CHANGED.cause: The export destination changed after you chose it.

DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The selected directory can be restored or made accessible.
DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The export destination folder cannot be opened.

DEVICE_RESTORE_FAILED.reason: Our device configuration restoration can succeed later.
DEVICE_RESTORE_FAILED.cause: Yap could not restore the device’s settings.

DISABLE_TELEMETRY.reason: This is a configuration key or file-format token, not an error; no retry policy applies.

DOMAIN_MAX.reason: This is a configuration key or file-format token, not an error; no retry policy applies.

DOMAIN_MIN.reason: This is a configuration key or file-format token, not an error; no retry policy applies.

DUPLICATE_SHORTCUT.reason: Two requested shortcut actions conflict and the caller must choose distinct keys.
DUPLICATE_SHORTCUT.cause: Two actions were assigned the same shortcut.

ENCODER_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The machine’s encoder or our selected configuration can be repaired.

EVIDENCE_FAILED.reason: The native evidence export is our implementation.
EVIDENCE_FAILED.cause: Yap could not export capture evidence.

EVIDENCE_LIMIT.reason: Our capture evidence limits and readers can be corrected; this is not proof of bad input.
EVIDENCE_LIMIT.cause: Capture evidence exceeded Yap’s current read or output limit.

EXPORT_ABANDONING.reason: Abandonment cleanup can finish or be explicitly retried.
EXPORT_ABANDONING.cause: The export is still being abandoned.

EXPORT_CLEANUP_FAILED.reason: Our export cleanup can succeed after repair.
EXPORT_CLEANUP_FAILED.cause: The export’s temporary files could not be cleaned up.

FFMPEG_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our bundled tool installation can be repaired.

FILE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: A filesystem access failure can be repaired; known missing caller references stay separate.
FILE_UNAVAILABLE.cause: A referenced file could not be read.

FIXTURE_FAILED.reason: The probe fixture, renderer and writer are ours.
FIXTURE_FAILED.cause: The capture probe could not prepare or read its fixture.

FONT_CHANGED.reason: The imported font’s owned bytes can be restored to their immutable identity.
FONT_CHANGED.cause: The stored font file differs from its imported identity.

FONT_GLYPH_BOUNDS_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our font layout implementation can be corrected.
FONT_GLYPH_BOUNDS_UNAVAILABLE.cause: Yap could not measure the text’s glyph bounds.

FONT_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The requested face does not exist in the selected immutable font file.
FONT_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The selected font file has no face with that name.

FORMAT_CHANGED.cause: The selected capture device changed its format.

FORMAT_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The device’s active dimensions or cadence can change without changing the request.
FORMAT_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The selected camera has no usable format for this request right now.

FRAME_FAILED.reason: Picture preparation or its dependency can succeed on retry.
FRAME_FAILED.cause: A requested picture could not be prepared.

FRAME_TOO_LARGE.reason: Our framing/output budgets can be repaired; caller admission failures must use INVALID_PARAMS instead.
FRAME_TOO_LARGE.cause: The request or output exceeded Yap’s current frame budget.

HUMAN_QA_REQUIRED.reason: Our verification output is incorrect if it requires human QA; repairing the producer can succeed.
HUMAN_QA_REQUIRED.cause: Delivery evidence incorrectly requires human QA.

IDENTITY_COLLISION.reason: Our digest or retained metadata must be repaired.
IDENTITY_COLLISION.cause: Different job inputs resolved to the same internal identity.

INSPECTION_FAILED.reason: Inspection is our execution and can be retried.
INSPECTION_FAILED.cause: Yap could not finish inspecting the timeline.

INSPECT_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The native inspector becomes available after app repair or initialization.
INSPECT_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The native project inspector is unavailable.

INTERNAL_ERROR.reason: Unclassified failures in our code are retryable by rule.

INVALID_AUDIO.reason: Nonfinite PCM or gain arithmetic is our processor output.

INVALID_AUDIO_FORMAT.reason: Capture’s own PCM metadata can be repaired.
INVALID_AUDIO_FORMAT.cause: Recorded audio has unusable format metadata.

INVALID_AUDIO_TIMING.reason: Capture’s clock and sample-grid arithmetic are ours.

INVALID_CACHE.reason: Our derived cache can be rebuilt.
INVALID_CACHE.cause: Prepared output does not match its cache receipt.

INVALID_CAMERA_FRAME.reason: Device callbacks and our capture handling can recover.
INVALID_CAMERA_FRAME.cause: The camera delivered a frame without usable video.

INVALID_CAMERA_MAPPING.reason: Retained camera bytes, mapping or receipt disagree; the same immutable inputs cannot establish matching picture authority.
INVALID_CAMERA_MAPPING.cause: The recorded camera mapping or publication proof is invalid.

INVALID_CATALOG.reason: Our stored recording identity can be repaired.
INVALID_CATALOG.cause: The library contains an invalid recording storage identity.

INVALID_CLI_RESPONSE.reason: Our CLI response/exit behavior can be repaired.
INVALID_CLI_RESPONSE.cause: The Yap command returned an unreadable or inconsistent answer.

INVALID_CLOCK.reason: Our conversion of device timestamps can be corrected.
INVALID_CLOCK.cause: The capture clock returned an invalid timestamp.

INVALID_COMPOSITION.reason: The supplied selection or composition cannot describe the requested operation; owned compiler failures must split below.
INVALID_COMPOSITION.cause: The composition or selection is invalid for this operation.

INVALID_DESTINATION.reason: The producer is a failed creation of our default Downloads folder, not invalid caller parameters.
INVALID_DESTINATION.cause: Yap could not create its export destination folder.

INVALID_EDIT.reason: The edit request violates composition semantics.

INVALID_EVIDENCE.reason: Our captured and retained evidence can be repaired; caller evidence moves to INVALID_INPUT_EVIDENCE.
INVALID_EVIDENCE.cause: Yap could not read or verify its retained evidence.

INVALID_INPUT_EVIDENCE.reason: Malformed caller evidence or package content cannot succeed unchanged; do not use this for our capture journal.

INVALID_JOB.reason: Our persisted job recipe or export binding can be repaired.
INVALID_JOB.cause: The saved job does not match its expected work.

INVALID_JOURNAL.reason: The retained journal is malformed or has invalid ownership or mapping records; replaying those same bytes cannot make them valid.

INVALID_JOURNAL_PREFIX.reason: The immutable journal prefix or source/device allocation disagrees with recovery authority; retry cannot change that identity or invent provenance.
INVALID_JOURNAL_PREFIX.cause: The capture journal does not match its recovery authority.

INVALID_MEDIA.reason: The captured member is absent, invalid or inconsistent with its recorded format or authority; the same immutable input cannot satisfy publication.
INVALID_MEDIA.cause: The recorded media is absent or invalid.

INVALID_MODEL.reason: Our registered runtime resource definitions can be repaired.
INVALID_MODEL.cause: A registered model resource does not match its required format.

INVALID_NATIVE_RESPONSE.reason: Our native worker output can be corrected.
INVALID_NATIVE_RESPONSE.cause: A native media worker returned an invalid answer.

INVALID_NOTES.reason: The caller’s task-note document violates its schema.
INVALID_NOTES.cause: The supplied task notes are invalid.

INVALID_OUTPUT.reason: Our native output allocation and staging can be repaired; caller syntax failures split below.
INVALID_OUTPUT.cause: Yap could not allocate or verify its output file.

INVALID_PACKAGE.reason: A malformed caller-supplied package cannot be admitted unchanged; owned assembly and I/O producers split below.

INVALID_PATH.reason: A caller path that violates the operation’s path contract cannot be admitted; owned and I/O sites split below.
INVALID_PATH.cause: The supplied path is invalid for this operation.

INVALID_PERMIT.reason: The exact update permit reference is expired or superseded.
INVALID_PERMIT.cause: The update permit is no longer current.

INVALID_RANGE.reason: The selected interval or offset is invalid; a valid interval requires new parameters.
INVALID_RANGE.cause: The requested range is outside the available domain.

INVALID_REFERENCE.reason: The caller selected audio without the required canonical reference format.
INVALID_REFERENCE.cause: The selected voice reference is not valid for this model.

INVALID_REQUEST.reason: Malformed caller requests cannot succeed unchanged; internal encoding sites split below.
INVALID_REQUEST.cause: The request is malformed or unsupported.

INVALID_RESPONSE.reason: Our response producers can be repaired.
INVALID_RESPONSE.cause: Yap returned an unreadable or inconsistent response.

INVALID_SOURCE.reason: The caller’s verification source violates the source-preservation contract.
INVALID_SOURCE.cause: The selected verification source is invalid.

INVALID_SPEECH_TIMING.reason: Our speech engine generated the invalid timing.
INVALID_SPEECH_TIMING.cause: The speech engine returned invalid word timing.

INVALID_STATE.reason: Most sites describe our transient capture, job or publication state; irrecoverable reference cases split below.
INVALID_STATE.cause: Yap is not currently in the state needed for this operation.

INVALID_STORAGE.reason: Our managed directories and storage authority can be repaired.
INVALID_STORAGE.cause: Yap’s managed storage could not be verified.

INVALID_TIME.reason: Compiled clock precision and arithmetic are our implementation; malformed caller ranges belong to INVALID_RANGE.
INVALID_TIME.cause: Yap could not represent the requested timing accurately.

IN_USE.reason: References can be explicitly removed before repeating the same delete request.
IN_USE.cause: Other library items still use this item.

IO_ERROR.reason: The machine can regain descriptor or I/O capacity.
IO_ERROR.cause: Yap could not retain the prepared audio file.

ITU_R_2020.reason: This is a configuration key or file-format token, not an error; no retry policy applies.

ITU_R_2100_HLG.reason: This is a configuration key or file-format token, not an error; no retry policy applies.

ITU_R_709_2.reason: This is a configuration key or file-format token, not an error; no retry policy applies.

JOB_FAILED.reason: Plain executor exceptions already store true, despite the ledger’s false value.

JOB_INTERRUPTED.reason: Service restart or lost execution can be explicitly retried; SQL single quotes escape the scanner.

JOURNAL_CHANGED.reason: The journal or directory no longer matches pinned immutable authority; retry cannot make replaced bytes the same input.
JOURNAL_CHANGED.cause: The capture journal changed while Yap was opening it.

JOURNAL_CLOSED.reason: The publication journal lease has ended; the same closed authority cannot publish or be revived.
JOURNAL_CLOSED.cause: The current capture journal lease has ended.

JOURNAL_FAILED.reason: Our journal writer can be repaired.
JOURNAL_FAILED.cause: The take could not record its own state transition.

JOURNAL_MISSING.reason: Our capture journal can be recovered or restored.
JOURNAL_MISSING.cause: The take’s capture journal is missing.

JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our journal read permissions and I/O can recover.
JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE.cause: Yap cannot read the capture journal right now.

LAUNCH_FAILED.reason: Our app launcher or machine can recover.
LAUNCH_FAILED.cause: The Yap app could not be launched.

LIMIT_EXCEEDED.reason: These broad codes include our guessed storage/output limits; invalid caller parameters must remain separate.
LIMIT_EXCEEDED.cause: The operation exceeded one of Yap’s current resource limits.

LOGIN_ITEM_FAILED.reason: The machine’s login registration or our response encoding can recover.
LOGIN_ITEM_FAILED.cause: Yap could not read or change its login registration.

LUT_3D_SIZE.reason: This is a configuration key or file-format token, not an error; no retry policy applies.

LUT_CHANGED.reason: Our retained imported LUT bytes can be restored; currently this is a message operand of UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA.
LUT_CHANGED.cause: The stored color LUT differs from its imported identity.

MALFORMED_FRAME.reason: Malformed caller wire input needs correction; response/internal framing moves to INVALID_RESPONSE.
MALFORMED_FRAME.cause: The request is not a valid JSON frame.

MATERIALIZATION_FAILED.reason: Our captured PCM materializer can be repaired.
MATERIALIZATION_FAILED.cause: Yap could not assemble the recorded audio.

MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our retained media access can be repaired.
MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE.cause: Yap cannot read the required media right now.

MEDIA_WORKER_FAILED.reason: Our worker can succeed after repair or a fresh execution.
MEDIA_WORKER_FAILED.cause: A media worker ended without a result.

MEDIA_WORKER_NOT_RUNNABLE.reason: Our packaged worker executable or machine can be repaired.
MEDIA_WORKER_NOT_RUNNABLE.cause: The packaged media worker could not run.

MEDIA_WORKER_TIMEOUT.reason: A later worker execution can finish.
MEDIA_WORKER_TIMEOUT.cause: The media worker did not answer in time.

MEDIA_WORKER_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our packaged executable and its path can be repaired.

MICROPHONE_PERMISSION_REQUIRED.reason: Granting microphone access can make the request succeed.

MISSING_MEDIA.reason: The requested source file is absent from the immutable take; retry cannot supply the missing captured bytes.
MISSING_MEDIA.cause: The take is missing its source media.

MODEL_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.reason: A later acquisition of our registered artifact can succeed.

MODEL_HASH_MISMATCH.reason: Our downloaded/prepared model bytes can be reacquired.
MODEL_HASH_MISMATCH.cause: The model files do not match their registered identity.

MODEL_INVALID.reason: Our prepared speech model files can be repaired.
MODEL_INVALID.cause: The prepared speech model files are invalid.

MODEL_IN_USE.reason: Active jobs can release the model.
MODEL_IN_USE.cause: A running job is using this model.

MODEL_NOT_PREPARED.reason: Explicit preparation can supply our model/runtime files.
MODEL_NOT_PREPARED.cause: The required model has not been prepared.

MODEL_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED.reason: The machine or our execution implementation can change; this is not malformed caller input.
MODEL_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED.cause: This model cannot run on the current platform.

MODEL_RUNTIME_EXTRACTION_FAILED.reason: Our runtime assembly can succeed after repair.
MODEL_RUNTIME_EXTRACTION_FAILED.cause: Yap could not prepare the model’s runtime.

MODEL_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our runtime adapter can be installed or repaired.
MODEL_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The model runtime adapter is unavailable.

MODEL_SOURCE_REQUIRED.reason: This request omits a required explicit local artifact source.
MODEL_SOURCE_REQUIRED.cause: This model preparation requires a local artifact source.

MODEL_STORAGE_FAILED.reason: Our model filesystem can be repaired.
MODEL_STORAGE_FAILED.cause: Yap could not read or write its model files.

MODEL_STORAGE_FULL.cause: There is not enough free storage to prepare this model.

MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our prepared model files can become readable.
MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The prepared model files cannot be opened.

NATIVE_CAPTURE_FAILED.reason: Our capture implementation or machine can recover.

NATIVE_DECODE_FAILED.reason: Our native decoder can be repaired.

NODE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our interpreter installation or its configuration can be repaired.
NODE_UNAVAILABLE.cause: Yap’s required Node interpreter is unavailable.

NOTES_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The note resolver also wraps access/CLI failures; permanent missing identities must retain their specific code.
NOTES_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE.cause: A task-note reference could not be resolved right now.

NOTHING_TO_UNDO.reason: The same unpinned undo request can succeed after a later edit exists.
NOTHING_TO_UNDO.cause: There is no active edit to undo yet.

NOT_FOUND.reason: An explicit missing identity cannot be satisfied; unpinned latest-recording absence splits below.
NOT_FOUND.cause: The requested item does not exist.

NOT_READY.reason: Ordinary preparation can finish; vanished pins and bad requests are removed from this wait code below.
NOT_READY.cause: The requested work is not ready yet.

NOT_REQUESTED.reason: The original take never requested this track; waiting cannot add it.
NOT_REQUESTED.cause: This take did not request that audio track.

NO_CAMERA.reason: The ended take contains no accepted camera pictures; retry cannot record historical frames.
NO_CAMERA.cause: The take contains no camera pictures.

NO_NARRATION.reason: Our microphone capture or verification can recover.
NO_NARRATION.cause: The requested microphone produced no verified audio.

NO_RECOVERABLE_VIDEO.reason: Our recovery/decoder can be repaired; this status does not prove permanent loss.
NO_RECOVERABLE_VIDEO.cause: Yap has not recovered playable video from this take.

NO_SOURCE_MEDIA.reason: The ended allocation contains no retained source media; retry cannot create historical content.
NO_SOURCE_MEDIA.cause: The take contains no source media.

NO_SYSTEM_AUDIO.reason: Our system-audio capture or verification can recover.
NO_SYSTEM_AUDIO.cause: The requested system audio produced no verified samples.

NO_TRACK.reason: The captured file contains no requested track; replaying it cannot add that track.
NO_TRACK.cause: The recorded media contains no requested track.

NO_VIDEO.reason: Our capture writer or decoder can recover.
NO_VIDEO.cause: Capture produced no verified video samples.

OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.reason: Our script’s guessed cue/byte/output cap can be repaired; schema-invalid caller quantities belong to INVALID_PARAMS.
OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.cause: The requested output exceeds Yap’s current output budget.

OUTPUT_EXISTS.reason: The destination here is our owned private capture directory; staging can be repaired.
OUTPUT_EXISTS.cause: The private capture output folder is not empty.

OWNER_CLOSED.reason: Our service or read owner can be reopened for a new request.
OWNER_CLOSED.cause: The operation’s internal owner is closing.

OWNER_DELETED.reason: The deleted or deleting owner cannot be brought back by replaying its work request.
OWNER_DELETED.cause: The item that owned this work was deleted.

PACKAGE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our package workspace access can be repaired.

PACKED_MEDIA_INVALID.reason: The pinned packed bytes cannot be parsed as the required single audio track; replaying those bytes cannot satisfy the capture format.
PACKED_MEDIA_INVALID.cause: The packed capture media is invalid.

PARITY_UNSUPPORTED.reason: The caller’s replay proof requests a parity mode the verification contract does not accept.
PARITY_UNSUPPORTED.cause: Delivery replay requires byte-exact parity evidence.

PARTIAL_CAMERA.reason: Our camera publication or recovery can complete.
PARTIAL_CAMERA.cause: Some recorded camera media is still unresolved.

PERMISSION_REQUIRED.reason: Granting the requested machine permission can make the request succeed.

PINNED_IMPLEMENTATION_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The exact requested implementation identity is gone; selecting a current pin is a different request.
PINNED_IMPLEMENTATION_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The implementation pinned by this request is no longer available.

PREPARATION_FAILED.reason: Our preparation execution can succeed on a later explicit attempt.

PREREQUISITE_MISSING.reason: Our runtime, capabilities or retained metadata can be prepared or repaired.
PREREQUISITE_MISSING.cause: A required Yap component or prepared result is missing.

PRESET_NAME_UNUSABLE.reason: The supplied name contains no usable characters.
PRESET_NAME_UNUSABLE.cause: The preset name contains no usable characters.

PRESET_NOT_FOUND.reason: The referenced preset does not exist.
PRESET_NOT_FOUND.cause: The requested preset does not exist.

PRESET_NOT_LOCAL.reason: The referenced preset is not a local item that this delete request can remove.
PRESET_NOT_LOCAL.cause: The requested preset is not a local preset.

PRESET_REFERENCE_INVALID.reason: The supplied reference is neither an accepted URL nor an existing file reference.
PRESET_REFERENCE_INVALID.cause: The preset reference must be an HTTPS URL or an existing absolute file path.

PROCESSING_BUSY.reason: Current workers or leases can finish.

PUBLICATION_BUSY.reason: Another publisher can release its owned workspace.
PUBLICATION_BUSY.cause: Another publication still owns the temporary output.

PUBLICATION_CHANGED.reason: Our retained staging ownership can be repaired or reacquired.

PUBLICATION_CONFLICT.reason: Existing output bytes or receipts conflict with pinned publication authority; retrying the same inputs cannot authorize replacement.
PUBLICATION_CONFLICT.cause: An output conflicts with its publication proof.

PUBLICATION_FAILED.reason: Our media publication can succeed after repair.
PUBLICATION_FAILED.cause: Yap could not publish the recorded media.

PUBLICATION_IO.cause: Yap could not write or finish publishing the output.

RECORDING_BUSY.reason: The native worker can release this recording.
RECORDING_BUSY.cause: A native worker still owns this recording.

RECOVERY_BUSY.reason: Another recovery can release its workspace lock.
RECOVERY_BUSY.cause: Another recovery still owns this workspace.

RECOVERY_FAILED.reason: Our recovery execution can succeed after repair.
RECOVERY_FAILED.cause: Yap could not finish recovering the take.

RECOVERY_REFUSED.reason: Its current false classification derives from the helper denylist, including our own damaged files; permanent causes must project their own codes.
RECOVERY_REFUSED.cause: Yap could not verify the take during recovery.

REFERENCE_INVALID.reason: This producer validates our bundled use-case documentation, not caller parameters.
REFERENCE_INVALID.cause: Yap’s bundled use-case reference is inconsistent.

REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our bundled reference document can be restored.
REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE.cause: Yap’s bundled use-case reference cannot be read.

RENDER_WORKSPACE_BUSY.reason: The existing render can release its workspace.
RENDER_WORKSPACE_BUSY.cause: Another render still owns this workspace.

REPLAY_INCOMPLETE.reason: The caller’s verification request lacks the required clean and relocated runs.
REPLAY_INCOMPLETE.cause: The delivery replay evidence is incomplete.

REPLAY_MISMATCH.reason: Our delivery replay outputs can be corrected; a different caller brief must instead be rejected as INVALID_PARAMS.
REPLAY_MISMATCH.cause: The clean and relocated delivery results differ.

REQUEST_CONFLICT.reason: A durable request identity is already bound to different immutable parameters.
REQUEST_CONFLICT.cause: This request identity was already used for different input.

RETIME_FAILED.reason: Our sample timing conversion can be repaired.
RETIME_FAILED.cause: Yap could not retime the media samples.

REVIEW_FAILED.reason: Our review execution can succeed after repair.
REVIEW_FAILED.cause: Yap could not assemble the review evidence.

SERVICE_ENDED.reason: An updater-ended service can restart; show this lifecycle event as status.
SERVICE_ENDED.cause: The service stopped so an update can install.

SERVICE_LOST.reason: Our service lifetime can recover; capture media remains owned by native.
SERVICE_LOST.cause: The service connection was lost during the take.

SERVICE_MISSING.reason: Our service bundle can be reinstalled or repaired.
SERVICE_MISSING.cause: This Yap installation has no usable service bundle.

SERVICE_STOPPED.cause: The service stopped before confirming the operation.

SERVICE_TIMEOUT.reason: Our service startup can succeed after repair or another attempt.
SERVICE_TIMEOUT.cause: The service did not become ready in time.

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our service or its installation can be repaired.

SHORTCUTS_WRITE_FAILED.cause: Yap could not save its shortcut settings.

SMPTE_ST_2084_PQ.reason: This is a configuration key or file-format token, not an error; no retry policy applies.

SOCKET_IN_USE.reason: The other app/service can exit or serve the intended request.
SOCKET_IN_USE.cause: Another Yap process already owns the socket.

SOCKET_PATH_OCCUPIED.reason: Our socket location can be repaired after an unexpected file occupies it.
SOCKET_PATH_OCCUPIED.cause: A file is occupying Yap’s socket location.

SOCKET_PATH_TOO_LONG.reason: The path is our generated app socket path; our layout or machine configuration can be repaired.
SOCKET_PATH_TOO_LONG.cause: Yap’s app socket path is too long.

SOCKET_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our socket directory, permissions or machine resources can recover.
SOCKET_UNAVAILABLE.cause: Yap could not create or open its app socket.

SOURCE_CHANGED.reason: These producers verify our frozen capture/source copies and support; restoring owned bytes can succeed.
SOURCE_CHANGED.cause: Stored source media no longer matches its recorded identity.

SOURCE_DESTINATION.reason: The request explicitly selects an original source as the output destination.
SOURCE_DESTINATION.cause: An export cannot replace original source media.

SOURCE_LOST.reason: A disconnected camera, microphone, window or display can return.
SOURCE_LOST.cause: The selected capture source disconnected or disappeared.

SOURCE_PICTURE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: An exact source time in a declared physical gap has no picture; decoder failures must remain retryable under their execution codes.
SOURCE_PICTURE_UNAVAILABLE.cause: There is no physical source picture at the requested time.

SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: A selected device or our fixture/runtime can become available.
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The selected capture source is unavailable right now.

STALE_REVISION.reason: The request’s expected current revision is no longer current.

STATE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: This producer checks our delivery fixture root on the machine.
STATE_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The delivery replay folder cannot be opened.

STORAGE_BUSY.cause: Stored media publication is still changing.

STORAGE_CHANGED.reason: Our managed directory identity can be restored or reacquired.
STORAGE_CHANGED.cause: A managed storage directory changed while being opened.

STORAGE_ERROR.reason: Our import writer can succeed after filesystem repair.
STORAGE_ERROR.cause: Copying imported media made no progress.

STORAGE_IO.cause: Yap could not inspect its managed storage.

TIMEOUT.reason: A later execution or connection can answer.
TIMEOUT.cause: The operation did not answer in time.

TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED.reason: Our speech engine, model or machine can recover.
TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED.cause: The speech engine could not transcribe the audio.

TRUNCATED_FRAME.reason: A new connection can return a complete frame.
TRUNCATED_FRAME.cause: The connection ended partway through a JSON frame.

UNAVAILABLE.reason: The code mixes our repairable capabilities with impossible selections; split permanent input cases below.
UNAVAILABLE.cause: The required output or component is unavailable right now.

UNAVAILABLE_SUPPORT.reason: The exact selection crosses declared missing physical support; new selection parameters are required.
UNAVAILABLE_SUPPORT.cause: The selected audio includes unavailable source samples.

UNCORRELATED_RESPONSE.reason: Our transport or response identity handling can be repaired.
UNCORRELATED_RESPONSE.cause: The response did not match the request that was sent.

UNKNOWN_CLIP.reason: The requested clip or placement reference does not exist.
UNKNOWN_CLIP.cause: The requested clip does not exist.

UNKNOWN_OPERATION.reason: The caller named an operation outside the public operation contract.

UNKNOWN_SOURCE.reason: The selected asset/stream reference does not exist.
UNKNOWN_SOURCE.cause: The requested source does not exist.

UNKNOWN_TAIL.reason: Our sample inspection can be repaired to prove the final frame duration.
UNKNOWN_TAIL.cause: Yap could not determine the last recorded sample’s duration.

UNRESOLVED_START.reason: The start remains uncertain; replaying the same identity can resolve it.
UNRESOLVED_START.cause: The take’s start has not been confirmed.

UNSUPPORTED_CATALOG.reason: Our catalog reader or installation can be updated or repaired.
UNSUPPORTED_CATALOG.cause: This Yap build cannot read the library’s catalog format.

UNSUPPORTED_CLOCK.reason: Our movie-clock representation can be corrected.
UNSUPPORTED_CLOCK.cause: Yap cannot represent the movie’s required timing yet.

UNSUPPORTED_DESTINATION.reason: The explicit selected target is a symlink, which publication never replaces.
UNSUPPORTED_DESTINATION.cause: The selected destination is a symlink.

UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.reason: Our media readers/processors can gain the needed format support; malformed caller format values belong to INVALID_PARAMS.
UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.cause: Yap cannot process the required media format yet.

UNSUPPORTED_JOB.reason: The saved job recipe/dispatcher is ours and can be repaired.
UNSUPPORTED_JOB.cause: Yap cannot execute the saved job recipe.

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA.reason: Our media parsers and execution capabilities can be repaired; bad input selections split below.
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA.cause: Yap cannot process this media yet.

UNSUPPORTED_MODEL.reason: Our registered execution profile can be implemented or repaired.
UNSUPPORTED_MODEL.cause: Yap has no usable execution profile for this model yet.

UNSUPPORTED_PACKAGE_DEPENDENCY.reason: The producer explicitly says portable adoption is not implemented in our code.
UNSUPPORTED_PACKAGE_DEPENDENCY.cause: Yap cannot adopt this package dependency yet.

UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM.reason: Our machine or platform implementation can change.
UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM.cause: This operation is unavailable on the current platform.

UPDATE_BUSY.cause: An update is already in progress.

UPDATE_DISABLED.reason: The machine’s updater preference can be enabled.

UPDATE_FAILED.reason: Our update download or installation can succeed later.
UPDATE_FAILED.cause: The update could not be installed.

UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE.reason: The candidate is our release metadata/artifact; a corrected release or implementation can satisfy the same update request.
UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE.cause: The update candidate is incompatible with this installation.

UPDATE_LOCK_INVALID.reason: Our release lock metadata or machine permissions can be repaired.
UPDATE_LOCK_INVALID.cause: Yap’s update launch lock could not be verified.

UPDATE_PREPARATION_FAILED.reason: Our update admission/launch preparation can succeed after repair.
UPDATE_PREPARATION_FAILED.cause: Yap could not prepare to install the update.

UPDATE_SHUTDOWN_FAILED.reason: Our service can restart and later shut down cleanly.
UPDATE_SHUTDOWN_FAILED.cause: The service did not exit cleanly for the update.

UPDATE_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT.reason: Our service can restart and a later explicit update can complete shutdown.
UPDATE_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT.cause: The service did not stop for the update in time.

UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Our updater bundle/configuration can be repaired, including manual-only builds.
UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE.cause: This Yap installation cannot check for updates right now.

WRITE_FAILED.reason: Our capture writer, encoder or filesystem can recover.
WRITE_FAILED.cause: Yap could not write the recorded media.
